en: Sanborn Fire Insurance Map, Manahawkin, Ocean County, New Jersey, April 1918, Sheet 1
Sanborn Fire Insurance Map, Manahawkin, Ocean County, New Jersey, April 1918, Sheet 2

properties.name: East Bay Avenue / North Union Street

sheet-1.description: Sheet 1 of the two-sheet April 1918 Sanborn atlas of Manahawkin, drawn at 100 feet to an inch, covers the western half of the village around its crossroads. Main Street runs from the north edge, past the Baptist Church and a row of dwellings with long narrow lots, south to the junction with Stafford Avenue and Bay Avenue near the bridge over Mill Creek. West of Main Street the sheet shows Lake Manahawkin and Mill Creek in blue, with the dam and bridge where the road crosses the creek, and areas lettered farm land and marsh land. East of Main Street, Beech Avenue and Stafford Avenue run east to the Tuckerton Railroad, crossed by Division Street; Letts Avenue runs from Stafford Avenue south to Bay Avenue. The blocks hold frame dwellings and outbuildings, a cemetery, the public school, the Manahawkin Wrapper Company works with its garage and gasoline tank, the National Hotel, an old barn, ice houses, a bake shop, a hall with an office on the first floor, a storage building, the railroad station and a freight house with platforms on the Tuckerton Railroad, and the Standard Oil Company of New Jersey plant with kerosene and gasoline tanks and a pump house south of Bay Avenue. Block numbers 1 to 8 are printed in the blocks. The sheet carries the title cartouche (population 600, prevailing winds westerly, no water facilities, no fire department), the key, a north arrow, a scale bar and a small location map of New Jersey; the key and location map are left out of the mask. The west side of Main Street south of the hotel is only partly drawn.
notes: Beech Av. is Beach Avenue today; Bay Av. is East Bay Avenue east of Main Street (West Bay Avenue continues west over Mill Creek).
Railroad lettered Tuckerton R.R.; its freight house is lettered T.R.R. Freight Ho. The line is abandoned (only in the former-railway data).
Title cartouche: population 600, prevailing winds westerly, water facilities none, fire department none; public lights gas from Toms River; streets not paved.
Lettered land areas: Farm Land (northwest), Marsh Land (southwest).

Map, 100 ft to an inch, one part. West half of the village: Main St (north to south), Beech Av (modern Beach Avenue), Division, Stafford Av, Letts Av, Bay Av (modern East Bay Avenue), Lake Manahawkin and Mill Creek, Tuckerton R.R. at the east edge. Key box and location map masked out. Bay Av / Main junction not detected (west side of Main not drawn).

sheet-2.description: Sheet 2 of the April 1918 Sanborn atlas of Manahawkin, at 100 feet to an inch, covers the eastern half of the village beyond the Tuckerton Railroad. Beech Avenue crosses the top of the sheet from the railroad to the east edge, meeting Parker Street, which runs south to Stafford Avenue and then bends southwest to Bay Avenue. Stafford Avenue, drawn 80 feet wide, runs east from the railroad to Parker Street; Union Street runs from Stafford Avenue south to Bay Avenue, which crosses the lower part of the sheet diagonally from the railroad to the southeast corner. Most of the area is large, sparsely built lots: blocks 9 to 16 hold scattered frame dwellings, sheds, coops and wood houses, with the post office and general store and the M. E. Church on the north side of Stafford Avenue. The Tuckerton Railroad runs down the west side with sidings and a small building beside the tracks. At the west margin the sheet repeats in outline the Letts Avenue corner and block 1 of sheet 1; at the north edge the road continuing north of Beech Avenue is drawn only in outline, and several edges are marked no exposure. The sheet carries a north arrow, a title label (Apr. 1918, Manahawkin, N.J.) and a scale bar.
notes: Beech Av. is Beach Avenue today; Union is North Union Street; Parker is Parker Street; Bay Av. is East Bay Avenue.
Stafford Av. is labelled 80 ft wide on this sheet (50 ft on sheet 1).
Spaced single letters along the street from Parker south to Bay Avenue are not legible as a name.

Map, 100 ft to an inch, one part. East half: Beech Av (Beach Avenue), Stafford Av (80 ft), Union (North Union Street), Parker, Bay Av (East Bay Avenue), Tuckerton R.R. at the west edge; west margin repeats the Letts Av / Stafford Av corner of sheet 1. Parker / Stafford junction excluded (5.7 m residual, alone off the fit).
